script:
control-agent-server restart
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/events/count" --expect 409 --check retryable eq true --save F12.binding-required-after-restart/events
control-agent-server api PUT "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/credential-bindings/CODEX_AUTH_JSON" --json "{\"url\": \"$SRC/cred\"}" --expect 204
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/events/count" --expect 200 --save F12.binding-required-after-restart/events-after
control-agent-server state cat meta.json --conversation "$A" --check required_runtime_credential_bindings eq '["CODEX_AUTH_JSON"]'
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/prepare-for-sandbox-pause --expect 204
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/events/count" --expect 409
control-agent-server api DELETE "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A" --expect 200 --save F12.binding-required-after-restart/delete
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A" --expect 404
control-agent-server state ls --conversation "$A" meta.json --expect-count 0
